stories.title: Discovery of an Egyptian structure hidden for 2,600 years offers clues to ancient engineering
stories.summary: Archaeologists have rediscovered an ancient Egyptian structure that was hidden for nearly 2,600 years, with the first clues spotted from space.

stories.title: Utah Mammoth escape Nashville with 2 points despite abysmal goaltending in regulation
stories.summary: Although the Utah Mammoth found a way to escape Nashville with two points, it took a gritty late-game effort and a perfect shootout performance from Karel Vejmelka to secure the victory.

stories.title: Religious schools fight state rules to keep public funding — and their identity
stories.summary: Religious schools in Maine and Colorado fight to preserve the identity of their faith communities.

stories.title: 1 Utah university cracks '40 Beautiful College Campuses' list
stories.summary: One university in Utah made the list of the most beautiful campuses in the country.

stories.title: Army deems lead azide detonation a success but criticism lingers over notification
stories.summary: The detonation of the nation's aging stockpile of lead azide, which spurred widespread concerns about potential environmental contamination, has been deemed a success by the U.S. Army. But questions remain about how and when the federal government communicated its plans.

stories.title: When and where storms could slow your post-Thanksgiving travel
stories.summary: Another round of storms could slow the trip home from Thanksgiving for some across the country this weekend and into early next week.

stories.title: Salt Lake City considers 'discounted' lease for homeless village to quadruple land size
stories.summary: Salt Lake City is considering a lease that would allow the 8-acre Other Side Village to gain more than 29 additional acres at a similar discounted lease rate.

stories.title: Christmas Celebration brings Santa to Tooele, Grantsville
stories.summary: Two days after the Macy's Thanksgiving Day Parade waltzed through New York City, two more parades are scheduled to march through the streets of Tooele County, with Santa Claus set to appear at both.

stories.title: Parowan secures $5M federal grant for economic development
stories.summary: Parowan has secured a $5 million federal economic development grant to build a heavy-haul road and utility infrastructure connecting Main Street to its airport industrial park.

stories.title: More Utahns turning to alternative forms of birth control, research says
stories.summary: New research suggests more Utahns are relying on birth control alternatives that you don't find on pharmacy shelves.

stories.title: 'I was willing to try anything': NH mother sets record for living year with pig kidney transplant
stories.summary: Exactly one year ago, Molly Falco, 58, was the fourth person to receive a genetically modified pig kidney at Massachusetts General Hospital in Boston. Now, she's set the record for living the longest time with a non-human organ.

stories.title: Southern Utah mechanic keeps good times rolling one classic Volkswagen bus at a time
stories.summary: Michael Anderson is spreading smiles across southern Utah by building suspensions for classic Volkswagen buses, including his own 1963 model outfitted with a coveted personalized "VW" license plate.
